nativeValidation.method: Isolated temporary CODEX_HOME and cwd; app-server initialize then plugin/read against the repository local marketplace. An initial two-skill fixture also established direct-directory array support.
nativeValidation.result: Actual KLCode 0.1.0 source package returns 118 unique skill identities: 103 canonical workflows plus 15 explicit aliases. The requirements entrypoint reuses the canonical skill to prevent a name collision.
nativeValidation.scope: Native read-only source discovery only; not live lifecycle execution, desktop UI verification or installed-package validation.

limitations: The CLI plugin subcommand has no standalone validate or dry-run subcommand in this version.
Plugin role prompts are not established as native Codex agent registrations by plugin/read; separate reviewed agent configuration is required.
Non-managed hooks require host review and trust of their current definitions.
Supported denial output can block observed calls; hook launch failure, host timeout, untrusted hooks and unsupported tool paths are not a complete fail-closed enforcement boundary.
write_stdin transport does not run PreToolUse again for an existing execution session.

claude.nativeValidation: Not run: no Claude executable available in the inspected environment.
documentedCapabilities: Manifest skills paths accept directories containing skill folders or a SKILL.md directly.
Manifest commands accept custom directories; agents accept explicit Markdown files.
Command hooks support direct execution with command and args; Node avoids a Bash dependency.
onFailure:block requires Claude Code 2.1.295 or later.
Shell-command matchers must include both Bash and PowerShell on Windows.
